title: Neuromorphic Hardware Guide
summary: The Open Neuromorphic Hardware Guide is a community-maintained directory listing neuromorphic chips and architectures. It covers digital processors like SpiNNclouds SpiNNaker 2, Intel's Loihi 2, IBM's TrueNorth, and SynSense's DynapCNN alongside mixed-signal systems such as Heidelberg University's BrainScaleS-2, Innatera's Pulsar and imec's SENeCA. The resource details specifications for edge AI applications including ultra-low power consumption, on-chip learning capabilities, and event-driven sensing integration.
tldr: A community-maintained directory cataloguing neuromorphic hardware ranging from digital processors to mixed-signal chips with varying release dates between 2014 and 2025.
evidence: This directory provides a comprehensive overview of neuromorphic hardware, from pioneering past projects to the latest commercial and research chips.
